title: Nuraghe towers buried as if by a tidal wave

tellings.quote: they were suddenly submer they were suddenly covered in earth almost like a tidal wave had swept across the island

plain: The nuraghe, ancient stone towers on the island of Sardinia, were at some point buried all at once, according to a researcher named Tim Alberino. He says they "were suddenly covered in earth, almost like a tidal wave had swept across the island," and he gives no source or date for it. If true, it would point to a sudden disaster that swept over the whole island.
